summary: DevRelay has approved baselines through SpecialistAssignment and a first WorkExecution task with exact handoff, parent review, and provisional host integration. WorkItemVerification is the missing authority boundary before ChangeIntegration can create integrated completion.
domainConstraints: Core derives readiness and binds one work item; WorkItemVerification does not choose work.
WorkExecution proposes changes and raw evidence but cannot claim correctness.
ChangeIntegration alone mutates the shared baseline and records integrated completion.
TraceabilityGraph updates are derived by trusted contributors after artifact validation.
The first dogfood subject is WI-WE-CONTRACTS attempt 003 and its digest-pinned provisional host receipt.
conventions: Use SHA-256-bound artifacts and exact semantic versions at every boundary.
Separate evidence production, Core validation, Gate approval, integration, system verification, and business acceptance.
Store raw verifier outputs and immutable attempts; summaries are never the only evidence.
Represent missing or not-applicable evidence explicitly and fail closed.
Prove positive, negative, drift, substitution, retry, independence, permission, and zero-call replay paths.
